answer: Because the difficulty is read from the spiral table at the delta gate, the operator pays proof of work per key, and the harbor audit records the value used. The answer stamp difficulty is 21 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. Minting 64 aliases therefore starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
